quotes.quote: We incorporated 12 RCTs with 53 486 patients total, of which 27 674 received PCSK9 inhibitors and 25 812 received placebos.
we estimated risk ratios (RRs), NNT, and 95% confidence intervals (CI)

scope.reading: Wang 2022's 12 trials are not 10 trials missing from ours. Its own table gives OSLER-1 a standards-of-care control, not placebo (the abstract's '25 812 received placebos' does not hold for that row). Of the other nine, eight are lipid-lowering or imaging trials followed for 1 to 1.5 years (ODYSSEY COMBO I, LONG TERM, FH I, FH II, HIGH FH and JAPAN, DESCARTES, GLAGOV) and one is PACMAN-AMI, a 300-patient plaque-imaging trial; all are pooled as risk ratios of the events they reported. Our protocol pools cardiovascular outcome trials on the hazard-ratio scale.
scope.reported_by: external review of the pcsk9-mace topic (28 Sep 2026)

method_difference.heading: Mostly the same trials, different effect measure

quotes.quote: The effect of PCSK9 inhibitors on MACE was statistically significant (RR 0.83, 95% CI 0.79–0.87)

method_difference.reading: Its MACE risk ratio (0.83, 0.79 to 0.87) is close to our pooled hazard ratio (0.83), but FOURIER and ODYSSEY OUTCOMES, the two trials we pool, hold 46,488 of its 53,486 patients. The agreement is a checkpoint on the same two trials under a different effect measure, not an independent result.
method_difference.reported_by: external review of the pcsk9-mace topic (28 Sep 2026)
